papers.title: Corrupt Plans, Clean Traces: Evading Chain-of-Thought Monitoring with Plan Injection
papers.abstract: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is a safety strategy where the reasoning of a large language model "actor" is inspected by a "monitor" (often another language model) for signs of unsafe planning, deception, or misalignment. We find that planting harmful but benign-sounding reasoning in the actor's context can steer it to perform adversarial actions while evading monitors, an attack we term "plan injection". papers.title: The Router Within: Eliciting Native Skill Routing from a Frozen LLM
papers.abstract: Skills extend an LLM agent beyond its parametric knowledge, and the gain they promise rests on picking the right one. Deployed harnesses route by preloading every skill's metadata into the context, which disperses the agent's attention and caps the library size. papers.llm_reason: 据摘要（arXiv 2609.15982v1）：The Router Within 用两个线性映射从 frozen LLM 自身的前向信号里读取 skill-routing 决策，替代'把全部 skill metadata 塞进 prompt'与'外挂检索管线'两条主流路线。属于 frozen-LLM native skill routing 的方法学资产——对 aiutil 长期关注的 agent 工程（如何让大库 skill 在不爆 context 的前提下被稳定挑选）是直接可借鉴的工程抽象。代码/benchmark：暂无，需打开 PDF 看两个线性映射与训练数据是否公开。

papers.title: A Chosen Future Can Still Be Rewritten: Causal Writability in Video Models

papers.title: Disentangling Representation Evolution in Transformers through Directional Decomposition
papers.abstract: Transformer representations evolve through learned additive transformations that either preserve their current direction or redirect it. papers.title: Verifiable by Construction: Claim-Level Evaluation of Verbatim Citation in Clinical Question Answering
papers.abstract: Large language models (LLMs) have been widely adopted for clinical question answering (QA). Current systems can attach citations to their answers, but these often point to broad texts, leaving time-pressed clinicians unable to verify them efficiently.
